trap.label: tom e registro
trap.right: Dear Professor, I would like to request an appointment.
trap.why: Em português já distinguimos “você” e “senhor”, mas o brasileiro transfere a informalidade do e-mail. Em inglês, ajuste o tom ao leitor.

mcq.q: I would like ___ request an appointment.

fix.wrong: I would like request an appointment.
fix.right: I would like to request an appointment.

rewrite.prompt: Formalize: “I want an appointment.” (I would like…)
rewrite.answer: I would like to request an appointment.

rewrite.prompt: Use polite request: “Send me the file.” (Could you…)
rewrite.answer: Could you please send me the file?
